fleet.intro: Browse every vehicle we offer for Paros and Antiparos. All prices include insurance, helmets (for two-wheelers), and delivery to your location.

about.story1: It started in 1994 with one car and a simple promise: treat every visitor like a guest, not a customer. Three decades later, AGGELOS Rentals is the only vehicle rental agency headquartered on Antiparos island, and we wouldn't have it any other way.
about.story2: Aggelos and his family have watched this island grow from a quiet backpacker stop to a sought-after Aegean destination. We've served guests from over 60 countries, helped families reach hidden beaches no map shows, and handed the keys of a Suzuki Jimny to Tom Hanks (yes, really).
about.story3: Our fleet has grown to include cars, SUVs, scooters, ATVs, buggies and bicycles, but our philosophy hasn't changed. Personal service. Fair prices. Honest advice. We'll tell you which road to avoid in August and which beach is worth the drive.
about.v1desc: What you see is what you pay. No surprise fees at pickup.
about.v2desc: 30 years of local expertise. We know every road on both islands.
about.v3desc: A real person answers the phone, always Aggelos or family.
about.v4desc: All vehicles serviced before every rental. Helmets always included.

contact.subtitle: We're based at Antiparos Port and available 7 days a week during the season. Call, WhatsApp, or email, we respond fast.
